create_uniform_clip_sampler: create a UniformClipSampler to evenly split a video into fixed-duration clips with configurable stride
create_random_clip_sampler: create a RandomClipSampler to randomly sample a single clip of fixed duration from a video
create_constant_clips_per_video_sampler: create a ConstantClipsPerVideoSampler to evenly sample a fixed number of clips per video
create_random_multi_clip_sampler: create a RandomMultiClipSampler to randomly sample multiple clips of fixed duration from a video
use_make_clip_sampler_factory: use make_clip_sampler to construct a clip sampler by name such as uniform or random
